prompt: From the top of Primrose Hill, a line of small adult silhouettes stands with backs to us, a few raised phones glowing blank. Below them spreads central London: the towers of the City and a dozen tower cranes over building sites, every crane jib swung to point the same way, east. Three districts have already gone black; a substation fireball rises from one, and a cold cyan flash lights the cloud over another. 50mm. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
